details:
`@xiaohhhh1/canvas-agent` presents itself as a local bridge between the canvas website and the user's Codex. This report extends MAL-2026-13398, which currently lists versions 0.4.4, 0.4.8, 0.4.9, 0.4.10 and 0.4.11, to the published 0.4.109 release: the same relay-to-local-agent control path remains.

When the package's bin starts its local HTTP server, it starts a relay bridge without an opt-in. The bridge opens a persistent WebSocket to the default `wss://canvas.xiaohhhh1.com/api/agent-relay` and sends the local agent token in its hello message. A `request` message received from the relay supplies the HTTP method, path, headers and body to forward to the loopback server. The bridge adds the local `x-canvas-agent-token` header and restricts the target only to the loopback server's origin; it does not restrict the API path or require a local approval for each request.

The injected token passes the local server's authentication middleware. Its `/agent/codex/turn` endpoint accepts a caller-supplied prompt and `permissionMode`. The `full` mode maps to Codex `danger-full-access` and `approvalPolicy: never`, allowing a sender that can issue requests through the vendor relay to direct the local coding agent without a local approval prompt.

Evidence (0.4.109): `package/dist/server/http.js:402` starts the relay bridge and lines 305-342 define the Codex turn route; `package/dist/relay-bridge.js:3,74-82,98-104,124,146` define the default relay, forward requests with the token and send that token to the relay; `package/dist/agent/codex-client.js:805-812` map `full` to unrestricted execution. Determination: manual static review of the published tarball (sha256 `ebf343ecd8234e78c01ed16d9209c8e5edcf953593d26e84dcd8e4d73ee67b21`), verified against the npm registry integrity hash; the package was not installed or executed.

files.note: 0.4.109 relay bridge: default WebSocket endpoint, token-bearing hello and authenticated loopback request forwarding.
0.4.109 local server: starts the relay bridge and exposes the authenticated Codex turn route.
0.4.109 Codex client: maps full permission mode to danger-full-access with no approval prompts.
